title: Mookhyang: The Origin
altTitles: มุกฮยาง ดิ ออริจิน
description: In the turbulent world of Murim, a young boy known only as Number 2044 is kidnapped and trained by the Demonic Sect to become an assassin. After surviving years of brutal training, he earns the name Mookhyang, but his ambition extends beyond assassination. Under the guidance of the master Yoo-Baek, he devotes himself to the sword and seeks to reach the highest realm of martial arts.
author: Jeon Dongjo
